name: GetOuterCallCenterDataList

parameters.help_en: The session ID of the robot
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The caller number, such as a user mobile number, customer service representative seat number, or robot number
parameters.help_zh: 发起方号码-用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等
parameters.name: from_phone_num

parameters.help_en: The callee number, such as a user mobile number, customer service representative seat number, or robot number

Acid.description_en: The acid in the WebSocket after an inbound call

BizId.description_en: The key document number, such as an order ID

BizType.description_en: The document number type, such as order

CallType.description_en:
The call type. Valid values:
1: inbound.
2: outbound
CallType.description_zh: 电话类型，有以下枚举： 1：呼入 2：呼出

EndReason.description_en:
The hang-up reason. Valid values:
1: The call ended due to transfer to a human agent.
2: The call ended during the robot phase without being transferred to a human agent.
3: The user actively hung up.
4: The robot actively hung up.
5: The call was disconnected due to a network exception
EndReason.description_zh: 挂断原因，有以下枚举： 1.转人工导致的结束 2.未转人工在机器人阶段结束 3.用户主动挂断电话 4.机器人主动挂断电话 5.网络异常原因导致的挂断电话

ExtInfo.description_en: The business information from the upstream system in JSON format, such as robot instance information
ExtInfo.description_zh: json，上游系统的业务信息等，如机器人实例等信息

FromPhoneNum.description_en: The caller number, such as a user mobile number, customer service representative seat number, or robot number
FromPhoneNum.description_zh: 发起方号码-用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等

InterveneTime.description_en: The time when the call was connected. For inbound calls, this is the same as gmt_create. For outbound calls, this is the time when the user answered
InterveneTime.description_zh: 通话接通时间，呼入就等同于gmt_creae，呼出就是用户接通时间

SessionId.description_en: The session ID of the robot

ToPhoneNum.description_en: The callee number, such as a user mobile number, customer service representative seat number, or robot number
ToPhoneNum.description_zh: 接听方号码-用户手机号码、客服坐席号码、机器号码等

UserInfo.description_en: The user information passed from the upstream system, recorded in JSON format
UserInfo.description_zh: 从上游系统带来的用户信息，json格式记录

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to trace the cause of an error
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于跟踪错误原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful
